text: Common Cold - Summary:A viral infection of the upper respiratory tract that is generally mild and self-limiting.
Common Cold - Symptoms:Runny or stuffy nose,Sore throat,Cough,Congestion,Mild body aches,Sneezing
Common Cold - Treatment:Rest,Hydration (water, juice, broth),Saltwater gargle for sore throat,Over-the-counter pain relievers (Acetaminophen, Ibuprofen)
Common Cold - Warning_Signs:Fever lasting more than 3 days,Wheezing or difficulty breathing,Severe sore throat or earache,Symptoms worsening after 10 days
Common Cold - Prevention:Frequent handwashing,Avoid touching face (eyes, nose, mouth),Disinfect high-touch surfaces,Avoid close contact with infected individuals
Viral Fever - Summary:A broad term for any fever caused by an underlying viral infection, often accompanied by generalized body aches.
Viral Fever - Symptoms:High body temperature,Chills and shivering,Muscle and joint pain,Headache,Fatigue,Loss of appetite
Viral Fever - Treatment:Bed rest,Increased fluid intake,Antipyretics (fever reducers like paracetamol),Cool sponge baths if temperature is very high
Viral Fever - Warning_Signs:Persistent high fever above 103°F (39.4°C),Severe headache or stiff neck,Confusion,Seizures
Viral Fever - Prevention:Maintain good personal hygiene,Vaccination (where applicable),Avoid sharing personal items like towels or utensils
Influenza (Flu) - Summary:A contagious respiratory illness caused by influenza viruses that can range from mild to severe.
Influenza (Flu) - Symptoms:Sudden high fever,Dry cough,Sore throat,Extreme exhaustion,Chills,Muscle aches
Influenza (Flu) - Treatment:Antiviral drugs (if prescribed by a doctor early on),Rest and hydration,Fever reducers,Steam inhalation
Influenza (Flu) - Warning_Signs:Difficulty breathing or shortness of breath,Chest pain,Sudden dizziness,Severe or persistent vomiting
Influenza (Flu) - Prevention:Annual flu vaccine,Hand hygiene,Covering coughs and sneezes,Staying home when sick
Dengue - Summary:A mosquito-borne viral infection causing high fever and severe flu-like symptoms, common in tropical regions.
Dengue - Symptoms:High fever (up to 104°F/40°C),Severe headache and pain behind the eyes,Joint and muscle pain (breakbone fever),Skin rash,Nausea and vomiting
Dengue - Treatment:Supportive care with fluids,Pain relief using Acetaminophen,Avoid Aspirin or Ibuprofen (increased bleeding risk),Medical monitoring
Dengue - Warning_Signs:Severe abdominal pain,Persistent vomiting,Bleeding from gums or nose,Rapid breathing,Extreme fatigue/restlessness
Dengue - Prevention:Use mosquito repellent (DEET/Picaridin),Wear long-sleeved clothing,Eliminate standing water where mosquitoes breed,Use bed nets and window screens
Malaria - Summary:A life-threatening disease caused by parasites transmitted through the bites of infected female Anopheles mosquitoes.
Malaria - Symptoms:Cyclical fever and chills,Sweating,Headache,Nausea/vomiting,Muscle aches
Malaria - Treatment:Prescription antimalarial drugs (e.g., Artemisinin-based therapy),Hospitalization for severe cases,Fluid management
Malaria - Warning_Signs:Confusion or impaired consciousness,Yellowing of eyes/skin (jaundice),Dark-colored urine,Difficulty breathing
Malaria - Prevention:Antimalarial chemoprophylaxis for travelers,Insecticide-treated bed nets,Indoor residual spraying,Using mosquito repellent
Typhoid - Summary:A bacterial infection caused by Salmonella Typhi, usually spread through contaminated food and water.
Typhoid - Symptoms:Prolonged high fever,Weakness and fatigue,Stomach pain,Headache,Loss of appetite,Rose-colored spots on chest
Typhoid - Treatment:Antibiotics (as prescribed by a healthcare provider),Fluid replacement,Nutritious, easy-to-digest diet
Typhoid - Warning_Signs:Severe abdominal pain,Intestinal bleeding,Confusion or delirium,Persistent high fever despite antibiotics
Typhoid - Prevention:Drink only boiled or bottled water,Eat thoroughly cooked food,Typhoid vaccination,Frequent handwashing with soap
COVID-19 - Summary:An infectious disease caused by the SARS-CoV-2 virus, primarily affecting the respiratory system.
COVID-19 - Symptoms:Fever or chills,Cough,Shortness of breath,Fatigue,Loss of taste or smell,Sore throat
COVID-19 - Treatment:Isolation to prevent spread,Rest and hydration,Symptomatic relief (fever reducers),Antivirals (for high-risk individuals, if prescribed)
COVID-19 - Warning_Signs:Trouble breathing,Persistent pain/pressure in chest,New confusion,Inability to wake or stay awake,Pale, gray, or blue-colored skin/lips
COVID-19 - Prevention:Vaccination and boosters,Wearing masks in crowded spaces,Maintaining physical distance,Good indoor ventilation
Diarrhea - Summary:Loose, watery stools occurring more frequently than usual, often caused by infection or food intolerance.
Diarrhea - Symptoms:Frequent loose stools,Abdominal cramps,Bloating,Nausea,Urgent need for bowel movement
Diarrhea - Treatment:Oral Rehydration Salts (ORS),Increased fluid intake,Bland diet (BRAT: Bananas, Rice, Applesauce, Toast),Probiotics
Diarrhea - Warning_Signs:Signs of severe dehydration (no urine, sunken eyes),Blood or mucus in stool,High fever,Symptoms lasting over 48 hours
Diarrhea - Prevention:Safe drinking water,Proper food handling/cooking,Handwashing after bathroom use,Rotavirus vaccination for infants
Dehydration - Summary:A condition where the body loses more fluids than it takes in, hindering normal functions.
Dehydration - Symptoms:Extreme thirst,Dark-colored urine,Dizziness or lightheadedness,Dry mouth and skin,Fatigue
Dehydration - Treatment:Sipping water or electrolyte drinks,Oral rehydration solutions,Intravenous fluids (in severe cases),Rest in a cool environment
Dehydration - Warning_Signs:Confusion,Fainting,No urination for 8+ hours,Rapid heartbeat or breathing

Dehydration - Prevention:Drink water regularly throughout the day,Increase fluid intake during hot weather/exercise,Eat water-rich foods (fruits/vegetables),Monitor urine color (should be pale yellow)
Food Poisoning - Summary:Illness caused by eating contaminated, spoiled, or toxic food.
Food Poisoning - Symptoms:Nausea and vomiting,Watery or bloody diarrhea,Abdominal pain and cramps,Fever
Food Poisoning - Treatment:Fluid replacement (ORS),Gradual return to eating bland foods,Rest,Avoid anti-diarrheal meds if fever/bloody stool is present
Food Poisoning - Warning_Signs:Frequent episodes of vomiting/inability to keep liquids down,Bloody vomit or stools,Neurological symptoms (blurry vision, muscle weakness),High fever (above 102°F)
Food Poisoning - Prevention:Wash hands and surfaces often,Separate raw meats from other foods,Cook food to the right temperature,Refrigerate perishables promptly
Gastritis / Acidity - Summary:Inflammation or irritation of the stomach lining, often leading to acid reflux symptoms.
Gastritis / Acidity - Symptoms:Gnawing or burning ache in upper abdomen,Nausea,Fullness after eating,Bloating,Belching
Gastritis / Acidity - Treatment:Antacids,H2 blockers or Proton Pump Inhibitors (PPIs),Avoiding spicy/acidic foods,Eating smaller, more frequent meals
Gastritis / Acidity - Warning_Signs:Vomiting blood (may look like coffee grounds),Black, tarry stools,Unexplained weight loss,Severe, persistent pain
Gastritis / Acidity - Prevention:Limit alcohol consumption,Avoid long-term use of NSAIDs (Aspirin/Ibuprofen),Manage stress levels,Quit smoking
Constipation - Summary:A condition characterized by infrequent bowel movements or difficulty passing stools.
Constipation - Symptoms:Fewer than three bowel movements per week,Hard, lumpy stools,Straining to have a bowel movement,Feeling of incomplete evacuation
Constipation - Treatment:Increase fiber intake (fruits, veggies, grains),Stay well-hydrated,Regular physical activity,Over-the-counter stool softeners or laxatives
Constipation - Warning_Signs:Severe abdominal pain,Blood in stool,Weight loss,Persistent change in bowel habits
Constipation - Prevention:High-fiber diet,Don't ignore the urge to have a bowel movement,Establish a regular routine for bowel movements,Stay active
Indigestion - Summary:A general term for discomfort in the upper abdomen, often occurring after eating.
Indigestion - Symptoms:Abdominal pain,Burning sensation in the stomach,Bloating,Nausea,Feeling uncomfortably full during or after a meal
Indigestion - Treatment:Avoid trigger foods (greasy, spicy),Eat slowly and chew thoroughly,Avoid lying down after meals,Antacids
Indigestion - Warning_Signs:Shortness of breath or sweating with chest pain,Difficulty swallowing,Frequent vomiting,Unintentional weight loss
Indigestion - Prevention:Manage stress,Avoid late-night snacking,Limit caffeine and alcohol,Maintain a healthy weight
Headache - Summary:Pain or discomfort in the head or face area, ranging from mild to severe.
Headache - Symptoms:Pressure or throbbing sensation,Pain on one or both sides of the head,Tension in neck or shoulders
Headache - Treatment:Rest in a quiet, dark room,Over-the-counter pain relief,Hydration,Cold or warm compress
Headache - Warning_Signs:Sudden, 'thunderclap' headache,Headache with stiff neck and fever,Headache after a head injury,Confusion or vision changes
Headache - Prevention:Regular sleep schedule,Staying hydrated,Managing stress,Avoiding known food/environmental triggers
Migraine - Summary:A type of headache characterized by severe throbbing pain, often accompanied by sensory sensitivities.
Migraine - Symptoms:Intense throbbing pain (usually one-sided),Nausea and vomiting,Sensitivity to light and sound,Aura (visual disturbances) in some cases
Migraine - Treatment:Specific migraine medications (Triptans),Resting in a dark room,Hydration,Preventative medications for frequent sufferers
Migraine - Warning_Signs:Sudden change in migraine pattern,Loss of vision,Speech difficulties,Weakness on one side of the body
Migraine - Prevention:Identify and avoid triggers (e.g., aged cheese, red wine, strong smells),Consistent meal times,Adequate sleep,Stress management techniques
Body Ache (Myalgia) - Summary:Muscle pain or soreness that can involve a small area or the whole body.
Body Ache (Myalgia) - Symptoms:Muscle stiffness,Dull or sharp pain in muscles,Tenderness to touch,Reduced range of motion
Body Ache (Myalgia) - Treatment:Rest and gentle stretching,Warm baths or heating pads,Over-the-counter anti-inflammatories,Massage

Body Ache (Myalgia) - Warning_Signs:Signs of infection (fever, swelling),Muscle weakness that doesn't improve,Pain that lasts more than a few days,Dark-colored urine (potential sign of muscle breakdown)
Body Ache (Myalgia) - Prevention:Warm up before exercise,Stay hydrated,Proper ergonomics at work,Adequate potassium and magnesium in diet
Back Pain - Summary:Physical discomfort occurring anywhere in the spine or back, from mild to disabling.
Back Pain - Symptoms:Aching or stabbing sensation,Pain that radiates down the leg,Limited flexibility/range of motion
Back Pain - Treatment:Gentle movement and walking,Heat or ice therapy,Physical therapy,Pain relief medication
Back Pain - Warning_Signs:Loss of bladder or bowel control,Numbness/tingling in the groin area,Pain after a fall or injury,Unexplained fever with back pain
Back Pain - Prevention:Maintain a healthy weight,Use proper lifting techniques (legs, not back),Core-strengthening exercises,Good posture while sitting/standing
Joint Pain - Summary:Discomfort, pain, or inflammation arising from any part of a joint.
Joint Pain - Symptoms:Swelling or redness around a joint,Stiffness, especially in the morning,Reduced ability to move the joint
Joint Pain - Treatment:Weight management to reduce stress on joints,Low-impact exercise (swimming, cycling),Ice/heat application,Anti-inflammatory medications
Joint Pain - Warning_Signs:Joint deformity,Inability to use the joint at all,Intense pain and rapid swelling,Fever with joint pain
Joint Pain - Prevention:Protect joints from injury (use gear),Stay active to keep joints flexible,Eat an anti-inflammatory diet (Omega-3s),Stay hydrated
Muscle Cramps - Summary:Sudden, involuntary contractions of one or more muscles.
Muscle Cramps - Symptoms:Sudden sharp pain,Hard lump of muscle tissue felt under the skin,Inability to move the affected limb temporarily
Muscle Cramps - Treatment:Gently stretching and massaging the muscle,Applying heat to tense muscles or ice to sore ones,Drinking fluids with electrolytes
Muscle Cramps - Warning_Signs:Severe discomfort with no obvious cause,Leg swelling or redness,Muscle weakness,Cramps that happen very frequently
Muscle Cramps - Prevention:Stay hydrated,Stretch before and after exercise,Ensure adequate intake of calcium, potassium, and magnesium,Avoid overexertion in hot weather
Sore Throat - Summary:Pain, scratchiness, or irritation of the throat that often worsens when swallowing.
Sore Throat - Symptoms:Pain or scratchy sensation,Difficulty swallowing,Swollen, red tonsils,Hoarse or muffled voice
Sore Throat - Treatment:Gargling with warm salt water,Drinking warm liquids (honey/lemon tea),Throat lozenges,Resting the voice
Sore Throat - Warning_Signs:Difficulty breathing or swallowing,Drooling (inability to swallow saliva),Visible white patches on tonsils,Fever higher than 101°F
Sore Throat - Prevention:Avoid sharing food/utensils,Wash hands frequently,Avoid smoking and secondhand smoke,Humidify indoor air
Cough - Summary:A reflex action to clear the airways of mucus, irritants, or foreign particles.
Cough - Symptoms:Dry or productive (phlegm) cough,Chest tightness,Throat irritation
Cough - Treatment:Stay hydrated,Use a humidifier,Honey (for those over 1 year old),Cough suppressants or expectorants (based on cough type)
Cough - Warning_Signs:Coughing up blood,Shortness of breath,Cough lasting more than 3 weeks,Wheezing
Cough - Prevention:Avoid air pollutants and smoke,Handwashing,Managing underlying conditions like GERD or asthma,Vaccination against pertussis and flu
Asthma (non-acute) - Summary:A chronic condition where the airways narrow and swell, producing extra mucus.
Asthma (non-acute) - Symptoms:Shortness of breath,Chest tightness,Wheezing (whistling sound) when exhaling,Coughing, especially at night
Asthma (non-acute) - Treatment:Inhaled corticosteroids (long-term control),Quick-relief inhalers (Albuterol) for flare-ups,Identifying and avoiding triggers,Regular follow-ups with a doctor
Asthma (non-acute) - Warning_Signs:Rapid worsening of shortness of breath,No improvement after using a rescue inhaler,Difficulty speaking due to shortness of breath,Fingernails or lips turning blue
Asthma (non-acute) - Prevention:Follow an asthma action plan,Avoid allergens (dust, pet dander, pollen),Quit smoking,Prevent respiratory infections
Bronchitis (basic) - Summary:Inflammation of the lining of the bronchial tubes which carry air to and from the lungs.
Bronchitis (basic) - Symptoms:Cough (often with clear, yellow, or green mucus),Fatigue,Shortness of breath,Slight fever and chills,Chest discomfort
Bronchitis (basic) - Treatment:Rest,Fluids,Cough medicine,Humidifier use,Avoiding lung irritants
Bronchitis (basic) - Warning_Signs:Fever higher than 100.4°F,Mucus containing blood,Difficulty breathing that prevents sleep,Symptoms lasting more than 3 weeks
Bronchitis (basic) - Prevention:Don't smoke,Wash hands frequently,Wear a surgical mask when exposed to fumes,Get the flu vaccine
Skin Rash - Summary:An area of irritated or swollen skin, which can be caused by various factors.
Skin Rash - Symptoms:Redness,Itching,Bumps or blisters,Dry, scaly, or crusted skin
Skin Rash - Treatment:Gentle cleansing with mild soap,Hydrocortisone cream (for itching),Calamine lotion,Avoiding the irritant
Skin Rash - Warning_Signs:Rash that spreads quickly over the body,Rash accompanied by fever,Painful rash or blisters in mouth/eyes,Signs of infection (pus, warmth)
Skin Rash - Prevention:Use hypoallergenic skincare products,Avoid known allergens/irritants,Maintain good skin hygiene,Wear breathable fabrics
Fungal Infection - Summary:A skin disease caused by a fungus (e.g., Athlete's foot, Ringworm, Yeast infection).
Fungal Infection - Symptoms:Itching and stinging,Red, scaly ring-shaped patches,Cracking or peeling skin,White patches in moist areas
Fungal Infection - Treatment:Over-the-counter antifungal creams/powders,Keeping the area dry and clean,Prescription medications for stubborn cases,Avoiding scratching
Fungal Infection - Warning_Signs:Infection not improving after OTC treatment,Widespread patches,Involvement of nails or scalp,Severe pain or swelling
Fungal Infection - Prevention:Keep skin clean and dry,Change socks and underwear daily,Don't share towels or hairbrushes,Wear flip-flops in public showers/pools
Minor Wounds / Cuts - Summary:Breaks in the skin surface, typically from sharp objects or abrasions.
Minor Wounds / Cuts - Symptoms:Bleeding,Pain at the site,Redness,Skin break or tear
Minor Wounds / Cuts - Treatment:Stop bleeding with direct pressure,Clean with water and mild soap,Apply antibiotic ointment,Cover with a sterile bandage
Minor Wounds / Cuts - Warning_Signs:Bleeding that doesn't stop with pressure,Deep or gaping wound (may need stitches),Signs of infection (pus, red streaks),Debris in the wound that can't be removed
Minor Wounds / Cuts - Prevention:Use caution with sharp tools,Wear protective gear during activities,Keep a first-aid kit handy,Ensure tetanus vaccination is up to date
Allergic Reaction (mild) - Summary:An immune system response to a substance (allergen) that is usually harmless.
Allergic Reaction (mild) - Symptoms:Hives or itchy skin,Watery/itchy eyes,Sneezing,Mild swelling
Allergic Reaction (mild) - Treatment:Antihistamines (OTC),Cold compress on hives,Avoiding the allergen,Topical anti-itch creams
Allergic Reaction (mild) - Warning_Signs:Difficulty breathing or wheezing (Anaphylaxis),Swelling of the lips, tongue, or throat,Rapid, weak pulse,Nausea/vomiting after a sting or food
Allergic Reaction (mild) - Prevention:Identify triggers through testing,Read food labels carefully,Inform others of your allergies,Keep emergency meds (like EpiPen) if prescribed
Diabetes (Education) - Summary:A chronic condition that affects how the body turns food into energy, leading to high blood sugar.
Diabetes (Education) - Symptoms:Increased thirst and urination,Unexplained weight loss,Blurry vision,Slow-healing sores,Extreme fatigue
Diabetes (Education) - Treatment:Regular blood sugar monitoring,Healthy meal planning,Physical activity,Insulin or oral medications (as prescribed)
Diabetes (Education) - Warning_Signs:Confusion or altered mental state,Breath that smells fruity (Ketoacidosis),Extreme dizziness/shaking (Hypoglycemia),Loss of consciousness
Diabetes (Education) - Prevention:Maintain a healthy weight,Stay physically active,Limit sugary drinks and processed foods,Regular health screenings
Hypertension (Education) - Summary:A condition where the force of the blood against the artery walls is too high, often called a 'silent killer.'
Hypertension (Education) - Symptoms:Often no symptoms (asymptomatic),Occasional headaches,Shortness of breath,Nosebleeds (only in very high stages)
Hypertension (Education) - Treatment:Reducing salt intake,Regular aerobic exercise,Weight management,Prescription blood pressure medication
Hypertension (Education) - Warning_Signs:Severe chest pain,Severe headache with confusion/blurred vision,Nausea/vomiting with sudden anxiety,Difficulty speaking or weakness (Stroke risk)
Hypertension (Education) - Prevention:Follow the DASH diet (rich in fruits/veggies),Limit alcohol and quit smoking,Manage stress,Monitor blood pressure at home
Anemia - Summary:A condition in which the blood doesn't have enough healthy red blood cells to carry adequate oxygen.
Anemia - Symptoms:Fatigue and weakness,Pale or yellowish skin,Irregular heartbeats,Cold hands and feet,Chest pain
Anemia - Treatment:Iron-rich foods (red meat, beans, spinach),Vitamin B12 or Folate supplements,Iron supplements (if advised by doctor),Treating underlying blood loss
Anemia - Warning_Signs:Severe shortness of breath even at rest,Fainting or severe dizziness,Rapid or pounding heart rate,Extreme pallor
Anemia - Prevention:Eat a balanced diet high in iron and vitamins,Vitamin C intake to help iron absorption,Regular check-ups during pregnancy,Addressing heavy menstrual cycles
Acute Pharyngitis (Strep Throat) - Summary:An inflammation of the pharynx, often caused by Group A Streptococcus bacteria, resulting in a severe sore throat.
Acute Pharyngitis (Strep Throat) - Symptoms:Sudden severe sore throat,Pain when swallowing,Fever,Swollen tonsils, sometimes with white patches,Tiny red spots on the roof of the mouth
Acute Pharyngitis (Strep Throat) - Treatment:Antibiotics (if bacterial),Pain relievers (Ibuprofen/Acetaminophen),Saltwater gargle,Throat lozenges
Acute Pharyngitis (Strep Throat) - Warning_Signs:Difficulty breathing,Inability to swallow saliva (drooling),Joint pain after the infection,Rash (Scarlet Fever)
Acute Pharyngitis (Strep Throat) - Prevention:Frequent handwashing,Don't share utensils or toothbrushes,Cover mouth when sneezing
Acute Sinusitis - Summary:Inflammation of the cavities around your nasal passages, often triggered by a cold or allergies.
Acute Sinusitis - Symptoms:Thick yellow or green nasal discharge,Nasal congestion,Pain and tenderness around eyes, cheeks, nose,Reduced sense of smell
Acute Sinusitis - Treatment:Saline nasal spray,Nasal corticosteroids,Decongestants,Antibiotics (only if bacterial)
Acute Sinusitis - Warning_Signs:High fever,Severe headache,Confusion,Swelling or redness around the eyes
Acute Sinusitis - Prevention:Avoid upper respiratory infections,Manage allergies,Avoid smoke and pollutants,Use a humidifier
Osteoarthritis - Summary:The most common form of arthritis, occurring when the protective cartilage that cushions the ends of the bones wears down over time.
Osteoarthritis - Symptoms:Joint pain during or after movement,Stiffness, especially upon waking,Loss of flexibility,Grating sensation in joints
Osteoarthritis - Treatment:Physical therapy,Weight management,Nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs),Corticosteroid injections
Osteoarthritis - Warning_Signs:Severe joint instability,Rapidly worsening pain,Inability to perform daily activities
Osteoarthritis - Prevention:Maintain a healthy weight,Exercise regularly (low impact),Avoid repetitive joint injuries
Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease (GERD) - Summary:A chronic condition where stomach acid frequently flows back into the tube connecting your mouth and stomach (esophagus).
Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease (GERD) - Symptoms:Heartburn, usually after eating,Chest pain,Difficulty swallowing,Regurgitation of food or sour liquid
Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease (GERD) - Treatment:Antacids,H2 blockers,Proton pump inhibitors (PPIs),Lifestyle and dietary changes
Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease (GERD) - Warning_Signs:Chronic cough,Weight loss,Persistent vomiting,Difficulty swallowing or food sticking
Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease (GERD) - Prevention:Maintain a healthy weight,Stop smoking,Avoid trigger foods (fatty/spicy),Don't lie down after a meal
Hyperlipidemia (High Cholesterol) - Summary:High levels of lipids (fats) in the blood, which can lead to plaque buildup in arteries.
Hyperlipidemia (High Cholesterol) - Symptoms:Usually no symptoms,Yellowish deposits around eyes (Xanthelasma) in severe cases
Hyperlipidemia (High Cholesterol) - Treatment:Statins,Healthy diet (low saturated fats),Aerobic exercise,Weight loss
Hyperlipidemia (High Cholesterol) - Warning_Signs:Chest pain (Angina),Signs of stroke (slurred speech, weakness),Leg pain when walking (PAD)
Hyperlipidemia (High Cholesterol) - Prevention:Eat heart-healthy foods,Regular exercise,Avoid smoking,Limit alcohol consumption
Hypothyroidism - Summary:A condition in which the thyroid gland doesn't produce enough of certain crucial hormones.
Hypothyroidism - Symptoms:Fatigue,Increased sensitivity to cold,Weight gain,Dry skin,Thinning hair
Hypothyroidism - Treatment:Levothyroxine (synthetic thyroid hormone),Regular blood tests (TSH/T4),Consistent medication schedule
Hypothyroidism - Warning_Signs:Depression,Goiter (enlarged thyroid),Memory issues,Myxedema coma (severe, life-threatening cases)
Hypothyroidism - Prevention:Ensure adequate iodine intake (iodized salt),Screening for high-risk groups (pregnant women/seniors)
Generalized Anxiety Disorder (GAD) - Summary:A mental health condition characterized by persistent and excessive worry about various things.
Generalized Anxiety Disorder (GAD) - Symptoms:Restlessness,Fatigue,Difficulty concentrating,Irritability,Muscle tension,Sleep disturbances
Generalized Anxiety Disorder (GAD) - Treatment:Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT),Antidepressants (SSRIs/SNRIs),Mindfulness and meditation,Lifestyle changes (exercise/sleep)
Generalized Anxiety Disorder (GAD) - Warning_Signs:Panic attacks,Social isolation,Physical symptoms like chronic headaches or IBS,Suicidal ideation
Generalized Anxiety Disorder (GAD) - Prevention:Early intervention,Stress management techniques,Avoiding caffeine and alcohol
Pneumonia - Summary:An infection that inflames the air sacs in one or both lungs, which may fill with fluid.
Pneumonia - Symptoms:Chest pain when breathing or coughing,Cough with phlegm,Fever, sweating, and shaking chills,Shortness of breath
Pneumonia - Treatment:Antibiotics (for bacterial),Antivirals (for viral),Cough medicine,Fever reducers/Pain relievers
Pneumonia - Warning_Signs:Blue tint in lips or fingertips,Confusion (especially in seniors),Very high fever,Inability to keep liquids down
Pneumonia - Prevention:Pneumococcal vaccine,Flu vaccine,Don't smoke,Maintain strong immune system
Tuberculosis (TB) - Summary:A serious infectious bacterial disease that mainly affects the lungs but can spread to other organs.
Tuberculosis (TB) - Symptoms:Cough lasting 3 or more weeks,Coughing up blood,Chest pain,Unintentional weight loss,Night sweats
Tuberculosis (TB) - Treatment:Long-term course of antibiotics (6-9 months),DOTS (Directly Observed Treatment Short-course),Isolation during infectious phase
Tuberculosis (TB) - Warning_Signs:Persistent fever,Loss of appetite,Severe shortness of breath,Swollen glands
Tuberculosis (TB) - Prevention:BCG vaccination (in endemic areas),Good ventilation,Screening high-risk contacts,Covering mouth when coughing
Urinary Tract Infection (UTI) - Summary:An infection in any part of the urinary system—kidneys, ureters, bladder, or urethra.
Urinary Tract Infection (UTI) - Symptoms:Strong, persistent urge to urinate,Burning sensation when urinating,Cloudy or strong-smelling urine,Pelvic pain (in women)
Urinary Tract Infection (UTI) - Treatment:Antibiotics,Increased water intake,Pain relievers (Phenazopyridine),Heating pad for pelvic discomfort
Urinary Tract Infection (UTI) - Warning_Signs:Back or side (flank) pain,High fever and chills,Nausea and vomiting,Blood in urine
Urinary Tract Infection (UTI) - Prevention:Drink plenty of water,Wipe from front to back,Empty bladder after intercourse,Avoid irritating feminine products
Coronary Artery Disease (CAD) - Summary:The most common heart disease, caused by plaque buildup in the wall of the arteries that supply blood to the heart.
Coronary Artery Disease (CAD) - Symptoms:Chest pain (Angina),Shortness of breath,Fatigue,Neck or jaw pain
Coronary Artery Disease (CAD) - Treatment:Lifestyle changes (diet/exercise),Statins or Beta-blockers,Angioplasty or Stenting,Coronary artery bypass surgery
Coronary Artery Disease (CAD) - Warning_Signs:Crushing chest pressure,Pain radiating to left arm,Sudden cold sweat,Nausea
Coronary Artery Disease (CAD) - Prevention:Maintain low cholesterol,Control blood pressure,No smoking,Manage diabetes
Atrial Fibrillation (AFib) - Summary:An irregular and often very rapid heart rhythm that can lead to blood clots in the heart.
Atrial Fibrillation (AFib) - Symptoms:Heart palpitations,Weakness,Dizziness,Shortness of breath
Atrial Fibrillation (AFib) - Treatment:Blood thinners (Anticoagulants),Beta-blockers,Cardioversion,Catheter ablation
Atrial Fibrillation (AFib) - Warning_Signs:Sudden fainting,Severe chest pain,Signs of stroke (drooping face, arm weakness)
Atrial Fibrillation (AFib) - Prevention:Limit caffeine and alcohol,Control high blood pressure,Regular physical activity,Reduce stress
Alzheimer's Disease - Summary:A progressive neurological disorder that causes the brain to shrink and brain cells to die, leading to memory loss.
Alzheimer's Disease - Symptoms:Memory loss affecting daily life,Confusion with time or place,Difficulty completing familiar tasks,Changes in mood and personality
Alzheimer's Disease - Treatment:Cholinesterase inhibitors,Memantine,Cognitive stimulation therapy,Safety and environment management
Alzheimer's Disease - Warning_Signs:Getting lost in familiar places,Severe suspicion of family/caregivers,Inability to swallow or move in late stages
Alzheimer's Disease - Prevention:Regular mental stimulation,Heart-healthy diet,Social engagement,Quality sleep
Parkinson's Disease - Summary:A brain disorder that leads to shaking, stiffness, and difficulty with walking, balance, and coordination.
Parkinson's Disease - Symptoms:Tremor (shaking) at rest,Slowed movement (Bradykinesia),Rigid muscles,Impaired posture and balance
Parkinson's Disease - Treatment:Levodopa/Carbidopa,Dopamine agonists,Deep Brain Stimulation (DBS),Physical and occupational therapy
Parkinson's Disease - Warning_Signs:Sudden falls,Difficulty swallowing,Severe depression or anxiety,Freezing of gait
Parkinson's Disease - Prevention:Regular aerobic exercise,Consumption of caffeine (linked to lower risk),Avoiding environmental toxins (pesticides)
Epilepsy - Summary:A central nervous system (neurological) disorder in which brain activity becomes abnormal, causing seizures.
Epilepsy - Symptoms:Temporary confusion,A staring spell,Stiff muscles,Uncontrollable jerking movements
Epilepsy - Treatment:Anti-epileptic drugs (AEDs),Ketogenic diet,Vagus nerve stimulation,Brain surgery (for focal cases)
Epilepsy - Warning_Signs:Seizure lasting more than 5 minutes,Slow recovery after a seizure,Second seizure follows immediately,Seizure during pregnancy
Epilepsy - Prevention:Preventing head injuries,Reducing risk of stroke,Prenatal care to prevent birth complications
Rheumatoid Arthritis (RA) - Summary:An autoimmune disorder where the immune system attacks the lining of the joints, causing painful swelling.
Rheumatoid Arthritis (RA) - Symptoms:Tender, warm, swollen joints,Joint stiffness (worse in mornings),Fatigue, fever, and loss of appetite,Symmetrical joint involvement
Rheumatoid Arthritis (RA) - Treatment:DMARDs (Disease-modifying antirheumatic drugs),Biologic agents,NSAIDs,Physical therapy
Rheumatoid Arthritis (RA) - Warning_Signs:Rapidly developing joint deformities,Numbness/tingling (nerve involvement),Chest pain (heart lining inflammation)
Rheumatoid Arthritis (RA) - Prevention:Quit smoking,Maintain healthy weight,Early diagnosis and treatment to prevent damage
Celiac Disease - Summary:An immune reaction to eating gluten that creates inflammation and damages the small intestine's lining.
Celiac Disease - Symptoms:Diarrhea and bloating,Fatigue,Weight loss,Iron-deficiency anemia
Celiac Disease - Treatment:Strict lifelong gluten-free diet,Vitamin and mineral supplements,Dermatitis herpetiformis medication
Celiac Disease - Warning_Signs:Severe malnutrition,Bone weakening (Osteoporosis),Infertility or miscarriage,Neurological problems
Celiac Disease - Prevention:No known prevention; managed through diet after diagnosis,Screening for first-degree relatives
Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) - Summary:A chronic inflammatory lung disease that causes obstructed airflow from the lungs.
Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) - Symptoms:Shortness of breath, especially during activity,Wheezing,Chest tightness,Chronic cough with mucus
Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) - Treatment:Bronchodilators,Inhaled steroids,Oxygen therapy,Pulmonary rehabilitation
Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) - Warning_Signs:Blue fingernails or lips,Inability to catch breath or speak,Confusion,Rapid heartbeat
Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) - Prevention:Don't smoke,Avoid secondhand smoke,Protect yourself from dust and fumes at work
Tonsillitis - Summary:Inflammation of the tonsils, typically caused by a viral or bacterial infection (such as Strep throat).
Tonsillitis - Symptoms:Swollen, red tonsils,White or yellow coating/patches on tonsils,Sore throat,Difficult or painful swallowing,Swollen lymph nodes in the neck
Tonsillitis - Treatment:Antibiotics (if bacterial),Hydration and rest,Saltwater gargle,Tonsillectomy (surgery) for chronic or recurrent cases
Tonsillitis - Warning_Signs:Inability to swallow fluids,Drooling (due to inability to swallow),Severe difficulty breathing,Muffled 'hot potato' voice
Tonsillitis - Prevention:Frequent handwashing,Avoid sharing food, glasses, or water bottles,Replace toothbrush after a strep diagnosis
Peritonsillar Abscess - Summary:A complication of tonsillitis where a collection of pus forms near the tonsils, pushing the tonsil toward the center of the throat.
Peritonsillar Abscess - Symptoms:Severe throat pain (usually one-sided),Fever and chills,Difficulty opening the mouth (trismus),Muffled voice
Peritonsillar Abscess - Treatment:Drainage of the abscess by a doctor,Intravenous or oral antibiotics,Pain management,Steroids to reduce swelling
Peritonsillar Abscess - Warning_Signs:Airway obstruction,Dehydration from inability to drink,Spreading infection to the neck or chest
Peritonsillar Abscess - Prevention:Prompt treatment of tonsillitis,Maintaining oral hygiene,Quitting smoking
Tonsil Stones (Tonsilloliths) - Summary:Small, hard white or yellow deposits that form in the crevices (crypts) of the tonsils.
Tonsil Stones (Tonsilloliths) - Symptoms:Bad breath (Halitosis),Sore throat,Sensation of something stuck in the throat,Visible white debris on tonsils
Tonsil Stones (Tonsilloliths) - Treatment:Vigorous saltwater gargling,Manual removal (if safe and advised),Laser tonsil cryptolysis,Antibiotics (if infected)
Tonsil Stones (Tonsilloliths) - Warning_Signs:Significant swelling of the tonsil,Difficulty swallowing,Persistent ear pain
Tonsil Stones (Tonsilloliths) - Prevention:Good oral hygiene (brushing/flossing),Gargling regularly after meals,Staying hydrated
Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD) - Summary:A long-term condition where the kidneys don't work as well as they should, often worsening over time.
Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD) - Symptoms:Nausea and vomiting,Fatigue and weakness,Changes in urination frequency,Swollen feet and ankles
Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD) - Treatment:Managing blood pressure and diabetes,Dietary changes (low protein/salt),Dialysis (in late stages),Kidney transplant
Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD) - Warning_Signs:Fluid retention (Edema),Sudden shortness of breath,Chest pain (fluid buildup around heart),High potassium levels
Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD) - Prevention:Control blood sugar and blood pressure,Stay hydrated,Limit OTC painkiller use (NSAIDs),Reduce salt intake
Osteoporosis - Summary:A condition that weakens bones, making them fragile and more likely to break.
Osteoporosis - Symptoms:Back pain (caused by fractured vertebra),Loss of height over time,Stooped posture,Bones that break easily
Osteoporosis - Treatment:Bisphosphonates,Hormone-related therapy,Calcium and Vitamin D supplements,Weight-bearing exercise
Osteoporosis - Warning_Signs:Sudden sharp back pain,Fracture from a minor fall,Visible hump in the upper back
Osteoporosis - Prevention:Adequate calcium intake,Weight-bearing exercise (walking, jogging),Avoiding excessive alcohol,Quitting smoking
Eczema (Atopic Dermatitis) - Summary:A condition that makes your skin red and itchy, common in children but can occur at any age.
Eczema (Atopic Dermatitis) - Symptoms:Dry, scaly skin,Itching, which may be severe,Red to brownish-gray patches,Small, raised bumps
Eczema (Atopic Dermatitis) - Treatment:Moisturizing regularly,Corticosteroid creams,Topical calcineurin inhibitors,Phototherapy
Eczema (Atopic Dermatitis) - Warning_Signs:Signs of infection (pus, yellow crusts),Skin is painful to the touch,Sleep loss due to itching
Eczema (Atopic Dermatitis) - Prevention:Identify and avoid triggers (soaps, sweat),Short, warm showers (not hot),Use 'fragrance-free' products
Gout - Summary:A form of inflammatory arthritis characterized by sudden, severe attacks of pain and redness in joints.
Gout - Symptoms:Intense joint pain (often big toe),Lingering discomfort,Inflammation and redness,Limited range of motion
Gout - Treatment:NSAIDs or Colchicine,Corticosteroids,Urate-lowering therapy (Allopurinol),Ice application
Gout - Warning_Signs:Repeated attacks (chronic gout),Joint damage/deformity,Kidney stones
Gout - Prevention:Limit purine-rich foods (red meat, seafood),Avoid sugary drinks and alcohol,Drink plenty of water,Maintain a healthy weight
